item.tib: khro bo rag sha bam chen rol pa spyi dril gyi gtor bzlog stod sku
item.coloph: gsang sngags khro bo bdag rdzogs yang snying thugs bcud 'di/ rgya gar sngags bdag gi mthu/ dran pa ye shes kyis mdzad/ bla ma yon tan gyi bka' rgyud na/ zhang zhung dran pa nam mkha' la shar/ de la ru dbye dbal dkar gyis zhus so/ de nas rims (rim) par brgyud na (nas) bdag la'o/ skal ldan cig dang 'phrad par shog
